author: New China TV
description: Sports and culture brought American and Chinese teenagers together for an unforgettable day on a Fuzhou campus. From making lacquer fans and trying the ancient game of touhu to playing table tennis, pickleball and fun football challenges, every activity became an opportunity to connect and build lasting friendships.
title: Chinese, U.S. teens bond through sports and culture in Fuzhou

author: New China TV
description:
Here, art is no longer confined to the gallery or stage.
#Cairo's #ArtStreetInitiative brings joy not only to passersby, but also to the painters and performers themselves, who say the street gives them a space to be seen, heard and appreciated.
title: GLOBALink | Art steps off stage, meets people in downtown Cairo

author: New China TV
description: China's improving intellectual property protection is strengthening the confidence of foreign businesses, according to Robin Smith, Vice President and General Counsel for China and Asia Pacific at the LEGO Group. In an interview with Xinhua, she shared how stronger judicial protection and more efficient enforcement have supported LEGO's operations and long-term investment in China.
title: LEGO VP: China's stronger IP protection gives foreign investors greater confidence

author: New China TV
description: The Qinghai-Xizang Plateau is known as the world's "Third Pole" for its high altitude and harsh environment. On July 1, 2006, the 1,956-km Qinghai-Xizang Railway reached Lhasa, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, ending Xizang's long history without a rail service. Join Xinhua correspondent Fu Tian as he traveled across the snowy plateau to uncover the story behind China's engineering miracle. xhtxs.cn/bdk4
title: Vlog | Qinghai-Xizang Railway: An engineering miracle atop world's "Third Pole"

author: New China TV
description:
"Our ancestors... are Chinese in their hearts."
Elyn MacInnis, founder of Friends of Kuliang, returned to Fuzhou in east China's Fujian Province to honor her late father-in-law, Donald MacInnis -- a U.S. Army Air Forces lieutenant who served with the famed Flying Tigers, fought alongside the Chinese people during WWII, and later taught generations of students in Fuzhou.
#China #Fuzhou #Kuliang #FlyingTigers #WWII #ChinaUS #Friendship #History #PeopleToPeople #Heartwarming
title: Founder of Friends of Kuliang retraces wartime friendship in Fuzhou

author: New China TV
description:
Every summer, thousands of pregnant Tibetan antelopes migrate hundreds of kilometers to reach their ancestral calving grounds--grassland in Nyima County, 5,100 meters above sea level, in the heartland of Changtang National Nature Reserve in southwest China's Xizang.
Xinhua's cameras are fixed on a mother. Watch the raw drama of birth in thin air. (recorded)
title: Birth on roof of world: Tibetan antelope calving season in Xizang's Changtang

author: New China TV
description:
#Europe is grappling with one of its most severe #heatwaves on record. Temperatures have soared above 40 degrees Celsius across several countries, pushing hospitals, emergency services, and public infrastructure to their limits. 
Despite improved warning systems and emergency plans, why does Europe still struggle to handle heatwaves?
title: Why Europe struggles to handle heatwaves?

author: New China TV
description:
What has contributed to China's remarkable development?
Tan Kok Wai, advisor to the Malaysian Democratic Action Party (DAP), said the key lies in the Communist Party of China's (CPC) long-term strategic planning and its unwavering commitment to putting the people first.
As the CPC marks its 105th anniversary in 2026, hear his insights on China's governance and development experience.
#CPC #ChinaMalaysia #ChineseModernization #Governance #Leadership #PakatanHarapan
title: CPC's success lies in its people-centered governance: Malaysian DAP advisor

author: New China TV
description: American youths attending a cultural exchange tour in Fuzhou, east China's Fujian Province, visited Fuzhou Panda World on Wednesday, where they learned about breakthroughs in giant panda breeding and conservation, as well as biodiversity protection efforts in China. #GLOBALink
title: U.S. youths explore Fuzhou Panda World

author: New China TV
description:
Three statements. Three different answers.
From blaming #Iran, to expressing doubt, to saying the truth may never be known -- U.S. President Donald #Trump's shifting account of a deadly school strike in Iran raises more questions than it answers. #Minab
title: Trump sidesteps questions on Minab school strike

author: New China TV
description: At Honor's HQ in Shenzhen, a showdown unfolded. On one side: 20 human artists. On the other: "Lightning" - Honor's humanoid robot - who already made history in April, winning a robot half-marathon in Beijing in 50:26, faster than the human half-marathon world record 57:20. #HumanoidRobot #RobotRace #TechVsHuman #Honor #LightningRobot #AI
title: Int'l artists take on Honor's record-breaking robot "Lightning"

author: New China TV
description:
What if you could fly straight over the edge of a waterfall?
Follow an FPV drone as it skims just above the rushing water. The Jiulong Waterfalls in Luoping, southwest China's Yunnan Province, is in peak flow season. #China #Yunnan #Waterfalls #Drone #FPV #Nature #Adventure #ExploreChina
title: FPV drone tour of Jiulong Waterfalls in China's Yunnan

author: New China TV
description: Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Navy ships Nanning and Hengyang entered the waters of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on Thursday morning. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | PLA Navy vessels Nanning, Hengyang arrive in Hong Kong waters
